senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of קֶרֶן)to emit horns or rays.

units: <cite ref="Chullin 60a:7">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 69:32">Ps. LXIX, 32</cite>) <he>מַקְרִין ברישא והדר מפריס</he> first it got horns and then hoofs; v. <cite ref="M02462"><he>מַקְרִין</he> II</cite>.—Y. R. Hash. III, 58ᵈ top (strike out <he>מקרן כתיב</he>).
